recipes.name: Ama Toza (Sweet Vinegar Base)
recipes.description: Sweet vinegar base used in many cold dishes and salsas. Foundation for yuzu cucumber salsa and other preparations.

recipes.name: Yuzu Kosho Dressing
recipes.description: Citrus-forward, spicy dressing made with yuzu kosho paste. Quite salty, balanced with amazu-tosazu drizzle.
ingredients: Yuzu kosho paste (yuzu, salt, green chili)

recipes.name: Red Anticucho Sauce
recipes.description: Peruvian-style spicy red sauce with aji panka. One of four components in Kampachi Aji Panka sauce.

recipes.name: Yuzu Miso Sauce
recipes.description: Sweet citrus miso sauce. Part of the four-component sauce for Kampachi Aji Panka.

recipes.name: Aji Amarillo Aioli
recipes.description: Creamy aioli with Peruvian yellow pepper. Used as accent dots on sashimi dishes.

recipes.name: Carrot Ginger Dressing
recipes.description: Fresh, vibrant dressing for salads. Used on Blue Prawn Salad with peppery greens.

recipes.name: Salmon Sweet Onion Salsa
recipes.description: Sweet onion-based salsa specifically made for King Salmon preparations.

recipes.name: Aki Ameli Aioli
recipes.description: Signature Nobu aioli used as finishing sauce on various preparations.
